decisions.why: Examples are antibiotic susceptibility discs with microgram dosing (e.g. Ampicillindicloxacillin 10 1Ug) - laboratory consumables for microbiology culture testing.
Examples are PCR/molecular assay kits and extraction cartridges (Allplex Hpv Hr Detection, Starmag 96X4 Universal Cartridge Kit) - laboratory reagent consumables.
Named 'Immunodiagnostic Tests' with immunoassay reagent codes - laboratory diagnostic consumables.
Sampling bottles and Calprotectin reagents/calibrators are lab consumables; Oc Sensor Pledia is an automated FIT analyser (equipment) - division spans both.
Mast Uri Plates and Mast Bacteruritest are agar plate/test-kit consumables for urine culture testing.
